tone_statements.citation: 南方都市报 [Southern Metropolis Daily] (走读岭南方言 series; interview with 班弨 Ban Chao, Jinan University). 2021-10-20. 广东连南八排瑶语：冷水读作“水冷”，“耍歌堂”是国家非遗 [The Bapai Yao language of Liannan, Guangdong]. Online news feature; NetEase mirror.
tone_statements.quote: 班弨告诉南都记者，瑶语在语音上最大的特点就是声母和韵母都比较多。勉语通常约有70个声母、50个韵母和8个声调，多的甚至有10至11个声调。八排瑶语则是勉语中比较独特的，仅有35个声母，39个韵母和9个声调。
tone_statements.translation: Ban Chao told the Nandu reporter that the most salient phonetic trait of Yao (Mien) is its large number of initials and finals. Mien usually has about 70 initials, 50 finals and 8 tones, some varieties even 10 to 11 tones. Bapai Yao, by contrast, is rather special within Mien, having only 35 initials, 39 finals and 9 tones.
tone_statements.locator: web article, paragraph 5 (after the 八排 village list)

tone_statements.citation: 班弨, 肖荣钦 [Ban Chao & Xiao Rongqin]. 2011. 连南八排瑶语使用状况与语言接触情况 [Language use and language contact of the Bapai Yao language of Liannan]. 暨南学报(哲学社会科学版) [Jinan Journal, Philosophy and Social Sciences] 33(2): 126-131. ISSN 1000-5072.
tone_statements.quote: 根据发音、构词方式、借词等细微差别，连南县内的八排瑶语又可细分为油岭、南岗、横坑、九寨、白芒、连水（东芒）、三排、金坑、军寮、大坪（火烧寮）、大掌和盘石等 12 种土语。这 12 种土语在声调上没有差异，人们在交流上也没有太多的障碍，但使用者对各种土语之间的差别较为敏感。
tone_statements.translation: On the basis of small differences in pronunciation, word formation and loanwords, the Bapai Yao language within Liannan county can be further divided into 12 local varieties: Youling, Nangang, Hengkeng, Jiuzhai, Baimang, Lianshui (Dongmang), Sanpai, Jinkeng, Junliao, Daping (Huoshaoliao), Dazhang and Panshi. These 12 varieties show no differences in their tones, and people have little difficulty communicating, but speakers are quite sensitive to the differences between the varieties.

sources.citation: Ratliff, Martha. 2010. Hmong-Mien Language History. Canberra: Pacific Linguistics (PL 613). 298 pp.
sources.tag: read: silent on stress
sources.note: Comparative work; Zao Min is sample language 11 (data via Wang & Mao 1995 / Mao 2004). No statement on Zao Min word stress. Sec. 2.1.3.2 (pp. 26-28): 'No language in the Hmongic branch has contrastive vowel length, nor do the Biao Min and Zao Min languages of the Mienic branch'; the only prosodic remark (p. 28) quotes Downer 1961:539 on Iu Mien reduced syllables with 'weaker stress and shorter duration.. strong iambic rhythm', explicitly about Mien, not Zao Min. Ch. 4 (p. 200): Zao Min keeps a regular /ʔa-/ noun prefix (citing Mao, Meng & Zheng 1982) and was called 'isolated' by Wong 1939:425…

sources.note: Journalistic report of Ban Chao's fieldwork results (the Jinan University team behind Xiao 2011 and Ban & Xiao 2011): Mien varieties usually have about 70 initials, 50 finals and 8 tones (some 10-11), whereas Bapai Yao (Dzao Min) is distinctive in having only 35 initials, 39 finals and 9 tones; the 12 tuyu do not differ in tone. sources.note: Sociolinguistic (UNESCO vitality) and contact study, not a tone description, but first-hand: states that the 12 local varieties (tuyu) of Bapai Yao - Youling, Nangang, Hengkeng, Jiuzhai, Baimang, Lianshui, Sanpai, Jinkeng, Junliao, Daping, Dazhang, Panshi - do not differ in their tones; all examples are transcribed with Chao tone digits (values 33, 51, 22, 55, 35, once 21 occur), and section 三 lists contact-induced changes in casual speech including a paragraph '声调的变化' (e.g. j35 san35 > j22 san35 铲子). No tone inventory table or count is given.
sources.venue: 暨南学报(哲学社会科学版) [Jinan Journal, Philosophy and Social Sciences]
